data.exact_reserve_text: During 2017 we released prior year reserves of $176.9m (2016: $180.2m). Our specialty lines division increased reserve releases as the post recession portfolio from 2012 onwards matures. Specialty lines releases also included amounts from the 2014/2015 cyber portfolio, an area that has more variability than the rest of the specialty lines account. This counter-balanced lower releases on short tail classes where the mechanical effect of reduced margins on reserve releases, along with the effects of a large series of natural disasters, is now visable. prior_year_events.impact_description: Maturing of the post-recession (from 2012 onwards) specialty portfolio increased reserve releases as claims experience matured favourably
Reserve releases included amounts from the 2014/2015 cyber portfolio (area with higher variability), contributing to releases in specialty lines

named_events.event_name: Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria; Mexican earthquakes; Californian wildfires
named_events.loss_description: Major contributors to an increase in net insurance claims of $248.8m, bringing 2017 total net insurance claims to $905.6m

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net release of prior year reserves of $176.9m in 2017, driven largely by favourable reserve development as the post-recession specialty portfolio (from 2012 onwards) and amounts from the 2014/2015 cyber portfolio matured. These favourable developments were partly offset by the impact of a series of 2017 natural catastrophes (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, Mexican earthquakes and Californian wildfires) which increased claims activity and reduced the scope for further releases on some short-tail classes.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development taken from the Managing Agent Strategic Report statement 'released prior year reserves of $176.9m' (assumed to be a gross release as stated). Technical provisions note shows total movement in claims provision (includes current year catastrophe movements) and is therefore not used for PYD. Claims development table is present but primarily shows percentages; gross absolute PYD figure not separately detailed elsewhere. All amounts are in the report's native currency (USD).
